opencode9Router.noCombos: No combos found. Refresh discovery or adjust the 9Router settings.
opencode9Router.instructionsFileHint: Absolute path to a markdown file (e.g. AGENTS.md) that defines this agent's behavior. Injected into the system prompt at runtime.
opencode9Router.baseUrlHint: Defaults to NINEROUTER_BASE_URL. Paperclip normalizes values like host/, host/v1, and host/v1/.
opencode9Router.apiKeyEnvHint: Stores only the variable name in the agent config. Paperclip reads the real value from its own environment at runtime.
opencode9Router.auxiliaryComboHint: Optional OpenCode small_model combo. Leave blank to inherit the global default, or force reuse of the primary combo below.
opencode9Router.alwaysReusePrimaryComboHint: Persists an explicit per-agent override so this agent ignores NINEROUTER_SMALL_COMBO and uses the primary combo for small_model.
opencode9Router.optionalComboPrefixHint: When set, only discovered combos starting with this prefix are shown.
opencode9Router.showAllCombosHint: Persists an explicit per-agent override so this agent ignores NINEROUTER_COMBO_PREFIX and discovers every combo returned by 9Router.
opencode9Router.comboCacheTtlHint: Discovery cache key includes base URL, API key variable name, and prefix. Use Refresh combos to bypass cache manually.
